metrics.profile_summary: Junior marketing professional specializing in social media management and content creation. Experienced in executing digital campaigns and managing social calendars for diverse brands.

experience.description: Manages social media strategies and calendars, designs content via Canva, and executes Facebook and Instagram campaigns.
Produced researched blogs, articles, and web copies, and managed social media updates.
Assisted in marketing strategy implementation, content creation, and competitive market analysis.
Handled content scheduling, community engagement, performance tracking, and influencer coordination.

strengths: Hands-on experience with social media ad platforms
weaknesses: Degree is in Psychology rather than Marketing/Business
No mentioned expertise in GA4 or budget/ROI reporting
evaluation.summary: The candidate is an entry-level social media specialist. They lack the seniority, leadership experience, and advanced analytical capabilities (GA4, CAC/LTV) required for a Marketing Manager role.
